prompt: Why is Sonia especially concerned about the cleaning claim?
promptZh: Sonia 為何特別在意清潔敘述？

options.text: It omits the fan’s colour choices
It promises a free cleaning service
options.whyZh: 草稿教顧客自行清洗，沒有服務承諾。

options.text: It could lead customers to immerse and damage the fan
options.zh: 可能讓顧客把風扇浸水而損壞風扇
options.whyZh: 草稿叫人把整台風扇放進水裡；正式簡介禁止馬達外殼浸水，Sonia 擔心顧客照做會損壞產品。

options.text: It makes the product seem too expensive
options.whyZh: 經理的擔憂是產品損壞，不是價格印象。
